results.title: Docs question about the action contract

transcript.user: What happens if Hyperion sends delete_file with only a file name?
transcript.steward:
My language model is unavailable right now (the model call failed), so here is the closest part of the HYPER-AI docs:

[1] **Actions**: Events with an `action` key make the IDE do something; the IDE prints nothing for them, so the agent should describe what it did in `response` events. Available actions: create_folder (path), delete_folder (path), create_file (path, content — creates the file and opens it), edit_file (path, content — replaces the file whole and opens it), delete_file (path). `path` is always relative to the workspace root — never absolute, never `..`. For delete_file, edit_file and delete_folder a bare name is accepted: the IDE searches the workspace and uses the first match. A full path is used as-is.

[2] **Reading a file**: Reading is not an action. The agent calls the IDE backend: GET /api/agent/file?path=… → 200 {path, content}, 404 {error: File not found}, 409 {error: Ambiguous file name, matches: [...]} when several files share the name.

Sources: [1] Hyperion Agent (Hackathon) — Actions › Actions (https://ide-tutorial.hyperai.di.uoa.gr/hyperion-agent/); [2] Hyperion Agent (Hackathon) — Actions › Reading a file (https://ide-tutorial.hyperai.di.uoa.gr/hyperion-agent/)
